title: CircleSeeker
description: Comprehensive eccDNA detection from PacBio HiFi sequencing data. CircleSeeker identifies, classifies and characterises extrachromosomal circular DNA using two evidence-based callers: CtcReads-Core, which reads the tandem-repeat concatemers that rolling-circle amplification leaves inside a single read, and SplitReads-Core, which infers circles from split-read breakpoints. Calls are classified as UeccDNA, MeccDNA, CeccDNA or XeccDNA.
